source: smoothing ladder level L4 (R1): docs/paper/ladder/ladder.json, produced by `jarambit smoothing-ladder` (crates/cli/src/smoothing_ladder.rs)

method.carried_over: every other objective is genome-derived (plate responses, sharpness, point profile, ring, holder, aesthetics) and is not re-solved on the smoothed mesh
method.re_measured: 3D mass (exporter volume + smoothed - input STL volume, x 0.00443 g/mm3, 4 decimals) and the solid tip (fem_solid/tip_solid.py R_CUT 30 mm, NL 4, NSUB 1 on the smoothed upper skin, then the evaluator's DOLFINx 0.9.0 cross-check on the same mesh)
method.withheld: CAD/B-rep objective (cad_watertight_and_single_solid, cad.cad_valid) is false on every smoothed level: a smoothed triangle mesh has no validated STEP solid (owner decision 2026-10-22); score_with_brep keeps it as exported
